← Type Setting

Changelog

v1.0, 2026-11-05

  • Type Setting calculates multi-column page layouts. A page size, margins, columns and a type size give column widths, gutters and line lengths on Bringhurst's principles, drawn as a page.
  • The calculator works in seven steps: intro, page, margins, columns, type, text, then the specification, which downloads as a PDF.
  • A GREP generator builds InDesign GREP patterns for words, digits, punctuation and enclosed text.
  • A start screen with an About drawer introduces the tooling, in the same shell as Form.
